theme_archetype.name: Archetype 1: Organic & Earthy
theme_archetype.rationale: Perfect for a calm, reflective, intimate reading experience. Avoids the noisy 'social media' look by grounding the UI in warm paper tones, allowing the colorful book covers and content to stand out.

scale.overline: text-[10px] tracking-[0.2em] uppercase font-sans font-semibold text-stone-400

rules: Headings must use Cormorant Garamond for an editorial, book-like feel.
Body text must use Manrope for high legibility on mobile.
Use italicized serif for quotes, highlights, and the 'locked insight' messages.
Background is a warm paper tone, not pure white.
Primary text is charcoal/ink, never pure black #000000.
Use terracotta (#C86A58) sparingly as the sole accent color for CTAs, active states, and highlights.

layout_spacing.container: max-w-md mx-auto h-[100dvh] relative overflow-hidden bg-[#F9F8F6] flex flex-col
rules: Mobile-first PWA approach. Lock width on desktop to a mobile-sized container (max-w-md) centered, to emulate native app feel.
Generous spacing: use p-6 or p-8 for sections.
Avoid equal-spacing center-aligned generic grids. Use vertical stacks and bento-style asymmetrical layouts where possible.
Calm, not bouncy. High damping on springs.
Use opacity and gentle Y-axis translations for entry.
No aggressive scaling or vibrating animations.

bottom_tab_bar.classes: fixed bottom-0 w-full max-w-md bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-[#EAE6E1] h-20 pb-4 flex justify-around items-center px-4 z-50
bottom_tab_bar.inactive_state: text-[#A8A5A1] hover:text-[#787571] flex flex-col items-center gap-1

book_card.classes: relative flex gap-4 bg-white p-4 rounded-xl border border-[#EAE6E1] items-center text-left
book_card.image_container: w-16 h-24 rounded shadow-sm overflow-hidden flex-shrink-0 bg-stone-100
book_card.progress_bar: h-1 w-full bg-stone-100 rounded-full mt-3 overflow-hidden

locked_insight_card.classes: bg-[#F4F2EE] border border-[#EAE6E1]/50 rounded-xl p-6 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center gap-3 w-full my-4
locked_insight_card.text: font-serif italic text-[#787571] text-lg blur-[3px] select-none
locked_insight_card.helper_text: text-xs font-sans text-[#A8A5A1] uppercase tracking-widest mt-2

activity_banner.classes: absolute top-4 left-4 right-4 bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-md border border-[#EAE6E1] shadow-sm rounded-full py-3 px-5 flex items-center gap-3 z-40

bottom_sheet.classes: fixed inset-x-0 bottom-0 max-w-md mx-auto bg-[#FCFBF9] rounded-t-3xl shadow-[0_-8px_30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)] border-t border-[#EAE6E1] p-6 z-[60] flex flex-col

primary_button.classes: w-full bg-[#C86A58] hover:bg-[#B35A4A] text-white rounded-full py-4 text-base font-medium transition-colors text-center shadow-sm

secondary_button.classes: w-full bg-white border border-[#EAE6E1] hover:bg-stone-50 text-[#2C2A29] rounded-full py-4 text-base font-medium transition-colors text-center

landing.layout: Hero image top (max-h-[40vh] object-cover rounded-b-3xl), rich Cormorant Garamond H1 'Begin your Reading Journey', solid body text, vertical stack of 3 Primary actions.
landing.ctas: 1. Start Reading Circle (Primary), 2. Join via Link (Secondary), 3. Solo Session (Ghost)

reads_tab.layout: Vertical scroll. Top section: Reading Circles (horizontal scroll of bento cards or vertical stack). Bottom section: Solo Reading.
reads_tab.card_details: Show book cover (colorful), title, unread insights count (subtle dot indicator), active readers avatars.

turns_tab.layout: Async activity feed. Top: Group progress bar (minimalist line with avatar markers). Feed items: 'User highlighted...', 'User unlocked...', threaded vertically with 1px connecting lines.

personal_tab.layout: Bento grid for analytics. Categories: My Thoughts, Vocabulary Bank, Saved Insights.

pdf_reading_screen.critical_rules: MOST IMPORTANT SCREEN. Must feel distraction-free.
pdf_reading_screen.top_bar: Transparent/Glass. Back button, Chapter title, minimalist progress dots.
pdf_reading_screen.content_area: PDF.js wrapper or scrollable text representation. Sepia/Warm filter if possible. Selected text triggers bottom sheet.
pdf_reading_screen.bottom_toolbar: Floating pill above screen bottom. Contains: Highlight (marker icon), Add Thought (quote icon), Add to Vocab (book icon).
pdf_reading_screen.social_layer: In-line highlight markers (underlines in pale terracotta). Tapping opens a bottom sheet with the threaded conversation or thought.
pdf_reading_screen.locked_state: If a user scrolls to a page with future insights they haven't organically reached based on their 'turn', show the Locked Insight Card inline.

completion_analytics.layout: Editorial layout. Massive serif numbers for stats. 'You read together for 42 days.' High contrast editorial typography.

image_urls.description: Minimalist calm abstract art, suggesting a reading journey with terracotta and sage accents. Use at the top of the Landing screen.
Vibrant deep blue and burnt orange abstract cover. Use as a book cover in the Reads tab to provide a colorful accent.
Lush forest green and soft peach abstract cover. Use as a book cover placeholder.
Vibrant mustard yellow and charcoal abstract cover. Use as a book cover placeholder.
Rich maroon and soft blush pink abstract cover. Use as a book cover placeholder.
Minimalist continuous line art illustration of an open book. Use for empty states (e.g., no reading circles yet, no saved insights).

icons_spec.rules: Use thin, minimalist icons. Avoid filled icons unless indicating an active tab state.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Apply `data-testid` to ALL interactive elements, buttons, inputs, links, tabs, and key text fields.
Install and use Cormorant Garamond and Manrope fonts via Google Fonts. Do NOT use Inter or Roboto.

Enforce a mobile-first constraint by wrapping the main application in `<div className='max-w-md mx-auto h-[100dvh] relative overflow-x-hidden overflow-y-auto bg-[#F9F8F6]'>` to simulate a native PWA on desktop viewports.
Do NOT use standard Shadcn cards. Use the custom component classes defined in `components.book_card` and `components.locked_insight_card`.
Use framer-motion for the bottom sheet modals and activity banners. Ensure animations are slow and calm (high damping).
Use lucide-react icons with strokeWidth={1.5} for a delicate, editorial feel.
The PDF Reading screen must prioritize the reading content. Keep the UI chrome minimal, using glassmorphism for top and bottom bars.
Never use dark-on-dark themes or purple gradients. Stick strictly to the warm paper, charcoal text, and terracotta accent palette.
